content: {"praised":["Acting is first rate throughout the series.","Robert Powell delivers iconic, charismatic portrayal of Jesus.","Landscapes in Tunisia, Morocco, Mexico enhance visual storytelling.","Director Franco Zeffirelli brings reverent, thorough depiction of Christ.","The series is engaging and compelling gospel story."],"criticized":["Several critical scenes were cut from the 40th edition.","Missing Judas meeting with Sanhedrin and last supper details.","The DVD version has playback errors and return restrictions.","Uncut version is preferred over 40th anniversary cut.","Some actors, like Powell, were not convincing as divine."]}
